description: Ask Canvas to package every active course (or the ones you pick) as a downloadable .imscc archive, in one step. Nothing in the courses changes. Use before the term ends. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true. Apps that can ask the user directly will show a confirmation instead.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

course_ids.description: Course IDs; omit for all active courses.

name: export_all_courses
title: Export All Courses
